description: Make an AI spokesperson video from one product photo. Choose a person and scene, write your selling point, and get a talking 9:16 ad in minutes.
h1: Explain Your Product on Camera with an AI Spokesperson
lead: Turn one product photo into a talking ad in minutes. Pick a spokesperson, give them your key selling point, and put your product in front of shoppers. No casting, no studio day.
benefits_h2: Put your product’s key point on camera

benefits.t: Get a talking ad in minutes
benefits.d: Pick a spokesperson, add one product photo and a short line, and have a vertical draft ready without casting, booking or a studio day.
Keep the same product photo, then swap the spokesperson, opening line or scene to make new angles for your ad tests.
Write one factual line about your product. The spokesperson delivers your script word for word, so each version stays on message.

steps_h2: How to Make an AI Spokesperson Video for Your Product in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: Upload your product, choose who explains it, then get a vertical ad you can put to work.

steps.d: Keep the product you sell visible from upload to final ad. Add one clear full view with its shape and color easy to see.
Make the selling point clear without booking a creator. Pick a spokesperson and setting, then write one line explaining why the feature matters.
Put a talking product ad into your next campaign. Download the vertical file and add captions, a price, or a promotion in your editor.

faq.q: What is an AI spokesperson video?
faq.a: It is a short ad where a generated on-camera spokesperson holds your product and explains one approved point. Start with one product photo and a line your team has checked.

faq.q: How do I give the spokesperson a script?
faq.a: Write one short sentence in the workspace. The spokesperson speaks that line with matched mouth movement, so keep claims specific and review the result before posting.

faq.q: Can I choose the person and setting?
faq.a: Yes. Choose from the available adult spokesperson scenes, then match the setting to where your product is used. Results can vary slightly, so review each draft.

faq.q: Which products work for a spokesperson ad?
faq.a: Handheld items with one clear feature work well, including skincare, snacks, drinks, pet supplies and fitness gear. Keep the product fully visible in the source photo.

faq.q: How is this different from hiring a UGC creator?
faq.a: A UGC creator films with your real product and may improvise. An AI spokesperson starts from your photo and follows your line, so you can make an ad in minutes at a far lower cost.

faq.q: Where can I use the finished video?
faq.a: Use the downloaded 9:16 file in TikTok Ads, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts or a product page. Add any required AI disclosure and platform copy before launch.

faq.q: Is the spokesperson a real customer?
faq.a: No. It is an AI-generated brand presenter, not a buyer or reviewer. Use it to explain your product and never invent a customer experience.

faq.q: Are these videos commercial, and how much does one cost?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads are cleared for commercial use under our terms. A 10-second spokesperson video uses 40 credits, shown before you start, and failed jobs return their credits automatically. Any captions, music or offer artwork you add still need separate rights.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded plain forest-green bottle as the exact product reference. Preserve its matte forest-green cylindrical body and black ribbed screw cap with no handle and no metal ring while an adult presenter holds it at chest height and explains its everyday use. No labels or logos.
